summary_md: **Dai Macedo ([@daimacedoa](https://x.com/daimacedoa/status/2115474955223626087))** uses **Agentic Context Engineering (ACE)** to show how repeated summarization erodes useful context ("works, except on Windows" becomes "works"), advising builders to check what survives in agent memory.

referenced_urls.title: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving...

relevance: A crisp illustration of context collapse in self-improving agents.

media.description: Three-panel comic 'Three summaries later…': an AI memory note reading 'This fix works. Except on Windows.' is summarized repeatedly until only 'This fix works.' remains, and a frustrated developer replies 'Great. I'm on Windows.'
media.ocr_text: Three summaries later… / Original AI memory: This fix works. Except on Windows. / Summarized. Again. And again. → This fix works. / Great. I'm on Windows.
